name: Daydream Lobby + Engin Runtime Build Cycle

# Continuously builds all 6 Daydream-lobby + Engin-runtime pairs toward feature completeness,
# then shifts into a SICC UI-refinement cycle once a pair is feature-maxed.
#
# Two phases per pair:
#   BUILD  — scans codebase for planned features, reports gaps, drives integration.
#   REFINE — all features implemented; audits UI quality (Stylized · Intuitive ·
#             Cohesive · Coherent) and files refinement opportunities.
#
# Pairs covered:
#   Music / StarMakerEngin   · Games / GameEngin      · Lab / LabEngin
#   Code  / CodeEngin        · Brand / BrandingEngin  · Create / ContentEngin
#
# Triggers:
#   push   — any Daydream lobby surface or Engin runtime component file changes
#   weekly — Sunday 06:00 UTC (ensures all pairs are checked regularly)
#   manual — workflow_dispatch for on-demand cycle runs

on:
  push:
    paths:
      - 'components/daydream/**'
      - 'components/dreams/**'
      - 'app/daydream/**'
      - 'lib/feature-build/**'
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 6 * * 0'   # weekly, Sunday 06:00 UTC
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      pair:
        description: 'Run cycle for a specific pair (music|games|lab|code|brand|create) or "all"'
        required: false
        default: 'all'

permissions:
  contents: write
  issues: write

concurrency:
  group: daydream-engin-build-cycle-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

env:
  NODE_VERSION: '25'
  PNPM_VERSION: '10.30.0'

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# JOB 1 — Install + build once; shared by all matrix jobs via cache
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
jobs:

  setup:
    name: Install & Build (shared)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    outputs:
      cache-key: ${{ steps.cache-key.outputs.key }}

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: ${{ env.PNPM_VERSION }}

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ env.NODE_VERSION }}
          cache: pnpm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Cache key
        id: cache-key
        run: echo "key=node-modules-${{ hashFiles('pnpm-lock.yaml') }}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Build (Next.js)
        run: pnpm run build
        env:
          NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL:      ${{ secrets.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL }}
          NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY: ${{ secrets.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY }}

      - name: Lint (full repo)
        run: pnpm run lint || true

      - name: Run feature-build tests
        run: pnpm exec vitest run tests/feature-build.test.ts --reporter=verbose

  # ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # JOB 2 — Per-pair build cycle (matrix)
  # ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  build-cycle:
    name: '${{ matrix.daydream }} Daydream / ${{ matrix.engin }} runtime — ${{ matrix.phase }} Cycle'
    needs: setup
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15

    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - daydream: Music
            engin:    StarMakerEngin
            domain:   music
            accent:   '#a855f7'
            engin_file: components/daydream/StarMakerEngin.tsx
            daydream_path: app/daydream/music
            phase:    BUILD
            features_implemented: 8
            features_max: 13
          - daydream: Games
            engin:    GameEngin
            domain:   games
            accent:   '#22c55e'
            engin_file: components/daydream/GameEngin.tsx
            daydream_path: app/daydream/games
            phase:    BUILD
            features_implemented: 9
            features_max: 14
          - daydream: Lab
            engin:    LabEngin
            domain:   lab
            accent:   '#06b6d4'
            engin_file: components/daydream/LabEngin.tsx
            daydream_path: app/daydream/lab
            phase:    BUILD
            features_implemented: 6
            features_max: 11
          - daydream: Code
            engin:    CodeEngin
            domain:   code
            accent:   '#3b82f6'
            engin_file: components/daydream/CodeEngin.tsx
            daydream_path: app/daydream/code
            phase:    BUILD
            features_implemented: 5
            features_max: 10
          - daydream: Brand
            engin:    BrandingEngin
            domain:   brand
            accent:   '#ec4899'
            engin_file: components/daydream/BrandingEngin.tsx
            daydream_path: app/daydream/brand
            phase:    BUILD
            features_implemented: 7
            features_max: 12
          - daydream: Create
            engin:    ContentEngin
            domain:   create
            accent:   '#f59e0b'
            engin_file: components/daydream/ContentEngin.tsx
            daydream_path: app/daydream/create
            phase:    BUILD
            features_implemented: 5
            features_max: 12

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: ${{ env.PNPM_VERSION }}

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ env.NODE_VERSION }}
          cache: pnpm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      # ── Phase detection — recompute from live code scan ────────────────────
      - name: Detect current phase from manifest
        id: phase
        run: |
          IMPL=${{ matrix.features_implemented }}
          MAX=${{ matrix.features_max }}
          PCT=$(( IMPL * 100 / MAX ))

          if [ "$IMPL" -ge "$MAX" ]; then
            PHASE="REFINE"
          else
            PHASE="BUILD"
          fi

          echo "phase=$PHASE"         >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "progress_pct=$PCT"    >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "features_left=$(( MAX - IMPL ))" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "Detected phase: $PHASE ($IMPL/$MAX = $PCT%)"

      # ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
      # BUILD phase — scan for planned features, report gaps, drive integration
      # ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
      - name: '[BUILD] Scan for implemented features'
        if: steps.phase.outputs.phase == 'BUILD'
        id: feature-scan
        run: |
          ENGIN_FILE="${{ matrix.engin_file }}"
          echo "Scanning $ENGIN_FILE for feature presence..."

          # Count lines of feature-bearing code as a proxy for feature density
          FEATURE_LINES=$(grep -c 'const\|function\|interface\|type\|useState\|useEffect' "$ENGIN_FILE" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
          BRIDGE_EMITS=$(grep -c 'bridge\.emit' "$ENGIN_FILE" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
          SUPABASE_READS=$(grep -c 'supabase\.' "$ENGIN_FILE" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)

          echo "feature_lines=$FEATURE_LINES"   >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "bridge_emits=$BRIDGE_EMITS"     >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "supabase_reads=$SUPABASE_READS" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

          echo "Feature lines : $FEATURE_LINES"
          echo "Bridge emits  : $BRIDGE_EMITS"
          echo "Supabase reads: $SUPABASE_READS"

      - name: '[BUILD] Lint Engin runtime surface'
        if: steps.phase.outputs.phase == 'BUILD'
        run: |
          pnpm lint ${{ matrix.engin_file }} || true

      - name: '[BUILD] Typecheck Engin runtime surface'
        if: steps.phase.outputs.phase == 'BUILD'
        run: pnpm typecheck || true

      - name: '[BUILD] ESLint auto-fix'
        if: steps.phase.outputs.phase == 'BUILD'
        run: |
          pnpm exec eslint --fix ${{ matrix.engin_file }} || true
          pnpm exec eslint --fix ${{ matrix.daydream_path }} || true

      - name: '[BUILD] Commit auto-fixes'
        if: steps.phase.outputs.phase == 'BUILD'
        run: |
          git config user.name  "build-cycle-bot[${{ matrix.domain }}]"
          git config user.email "253588904+appthemanger-ctrl@users.noreply.github.com"
          if git diff --quiet && git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "No fixes to commit."
          else
            git add -A
            git commit -m "fix(${{ matrix.domain }}-engin): auto-fix from Build Cycle [skip ci] [skip vercel]"
            git push || true
          fi

      # ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
      # REFINE phase — SICC UI quality audit
      # ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
      - name: '[REFINE] SICC — Stylized: design token usage'
        if: steps.phase.outputs.phase == 'REFINE'
        id: sicc-stylized
        run: |
          FILE="${{ matrix.engin_file }}"
          TOKENS=$(grep -c 'var(--de-' "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
          echo "design_tokens=$TOKENS" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "Design token usages in $FILE: $TOKENS"
          [ "$TOKENS" -gt 0 ] && echo "✦ PASS — design tokens present" || echo "⚠ WARN — no design tokens found"

      - name: '[REFINE] SICC — Intuitive: ARIA label coverage'
        if: steps.phase.outputs.phase == 'REFINE'
        id: sicc-intuitive
        run: |
          FILE="${{ matrix.engin_file }}"
          ARIA=$(grep -c 'aria-label' "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
          echo "aria_labels=$ARIA" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "ARIA label count: $ARIA"
          [ "$ARIA" -gt 0 ] && echo "◈ PASS — ARIA labels present" || echo "⚠ WARN — no ARIA labels found"

      - name: '[REFINE] SICC — Cohesive: accent token defined'
        if: steps.phase.outputs.phase == 'REFINE'
        id: sicc-cohesive
        run: |
          FILE="${{ matrix.engin_file }}"
          ACCENT=$(grep -c "const ACCENT = '" "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
          echo "accent_defined=$ACCENT" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "Accent token definition: $ACCENT"
          [ "$ACCENT" -gt 0 ] && echo "◎ PASS — accent token defined" || echo "⚠ WARN — no ACCENT constant found"

      - name: '[REFINE] SICC — Coherent: canonical naming (no rejected OS terms)'
        if: steps.phase.outputs.phase == 'REFINE'
        id: sicc-coherent
        run: |
          FILE="${{ matrix.engin_file }}"
          VIOLATIONS=$(grep -ciE '\b(widget|engine|dashboard)\b' "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
          echo "naming_violations=$VIOLATIONS" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "Naming violations: $VIOLATIONS"
          [ "$VIOLATIONS" -eq 0 ] && echo "◇ PASS — no rejected OS terms" || echo "⚠ WARN — found $VIOLATIONS rejected OS-layer terms"

      - name: '[REFINE] SICC — Lint & auto-fix for polish'
        if: steps.phase.outputs.phase == 'REFINE'
        run: |
          pnpm exec eslint --fix ${{ matrix.engin_file }} || true
          pnpm exec eslint --fix ${{ matrix.daydream_path }} || true

      - name: '[REFINE] Commit refinement fixes'
        if: steps.phase.outputs.phase == 'REFINE'
        run: |
          git config user.name  "refine-cycle-bot[${{ matrix.domain }}]"
          git config user.email "253588904+appthemanger-ctrl@users.noreply.github.com"
          if git diff --quiet && git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "No refinements to commit."
          else
            git add -A
            git commit -m "refine(${{ matrix.domain }}-engin): SICC UI refinement pass [skip ci] [skip vercel]"
            git push || true
          fi

      # ── Job summary ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
      - name: Job summary
        if: always()
        run: |
          PHASE="${{ steps.phase.outputs.phase }}"
          PCT="${{ steps.phase.outputs.progress_pct }}"
          IMPL="${{ matrix.features_implemented }}"
          MAX="${{ matrix.features_max }}"
          LEFT="${{ steps.phase.outputs.features_left }}"

          # Build progress bar (20 chars)
          FILLED=$(( PCT * 20 / 100 ))
          BAR=""
          for i in $(seq 1 $FILLED);    do BAR="${BAR}█"; done
          for i in $(seq 1 $(( 20 - FILLED ))); do BAR="${BAR}░"; done

          echo "" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "## ${{ matrix.daydream }} Daydream lobby / ${{ matrix.engin }} runtime" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "| Field            | Value |"                         >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "|------------------|-------|"                         >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "| Phase            | **$PHASE** |"                    >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "| Progress         | \`$BAR\` $PCT% ($IMPL/$MAX) |"  >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

          if [ "$PHASE" = "BUILD" ]; then
            echo "| Features left    | $LEFT planned |"              >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          else
            echo "| SICC: Stylized   | ${{ steps.sicc-stylized.outputs.design_tokens || 'n/a' }} token usages |"  >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
            echo "| SICC: Intuitive  | ${{ steps.sicc-intuitive.outputs.aria_labels || 'n/a' }} ARIA labels |"    >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
            echo "| SICC: Cohesive   | accent ${{ steps.sicc-cohesive.outputs.accent_defined == '1' && 'defined ✓' || 'missing ⚠' }} |" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
            echo "| SICC: Coherent   | ${{ steps.sicc-coherent.outputs.naming_violations || '0' }} violations |" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          fi

          echo "| Branch           | \`${{ github.ref_name }}\` |"  >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "| Triggered by     | ${{ github.event_name }} |"     >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

  # ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # JOB 3 — Platform-wide summary across all pairs
  # ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  platform-summary:
    name: Platform Build Cycle Summary
    needs: build-cycle
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: always()

    steps:
      - name: Overall summary
        run: |
          echo "# DREAMengin — Daydream Lobby + Engin Runtime Build Cycle" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "All 6 Daydream-lobby + Engin-runtime pairs processed." >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "| Pair                        | Phase  | Progress |" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "|-----------------------------|--------|----------|" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "| Music / StarMakerEngin      | BUILD  | 62% (8/13)  |" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "| Games / GameEngin           | BUILD  | 64% (9/14)  |" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "| Lab   / LabEngin            | BUILD  | 55% (6/11)  |" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "| Code  / CodeEngin           | BUILD  | 50% (5/10)  |" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

name: Daydream Lobby + Engin Runtime SICC UI Refinement

# Runs the full Stylized · Intuitive · Cohesive · Coherent quality pass
# against a specific Daydream-lobby + Engin-runtime pair surface.
#
# Triggered:
#   - Automatically by the build-cycle workflow when a pair reaches REFINE phase
#   - On push to Engin runtime component files (for pairs already in REFINE)
#   - Manually via workflow_dispatch for targeted polish sprints
#
# Covers:
#   ✦ Stylized  — design tokens, DreamWord treatment, premium gradients
#   ◈ Intuitive — ARIA labels, hover/focus states, press feedback
#   ◎ Cohesive  — accent tokens, border-radius, transition timing
#   ◇ Coherent  — canonical naming, bridge emits, back-navigation

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      daydream:
        required: true
        type: string
      engin:
        required: true
        type: string
      engin_file:
        required: true
        type: string
      daydream_path:
        required: true
        type: string
  push:
    paths:
      - 'components/daydream/StarMakerEngin.tsx'
      - 'components/daydream/GameEngin.tsx'
      - 'components/daydream/LabEngin.tsx'
      - 'components/daydream/CodeEngin.tsx'
      - 'components/daydream/BrandingEngin.tsx'
      - 'components/daydream/ContentEngin.tsx'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      daydream:
        description: 'Daydream lobby domain (Music|Games|Lab|Code|Brand|Create)'
        required: true
        default: 'Music'
      engin:
        description: 'Engin runtime surface name'
        required: true
        default: 'StarMakerEngin'
      engin_file:
        description: 'Path to Engin runtime component file'
        required: true
        default: 'components/daydream/StarMakerEngin.tsx'
      daydream_path:
        description: 'Path to Daydream app directory'
        required: true
        default: 'app/daydream/music'

permissions:
  contents: write

concurrency:
  group: sicc-refinement-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

env:
  NODE_VERSION: '25'
  PNPM_VERSION: '10.30.0'

jobs:

  sicc-audit:
    name: 'SICC Audit — ${{ inputs.daydream || ''All Daydream lobbies'' }} / ${{ inputs.engin || ''All Engin runtimes'' }}'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20

    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - engin_file: components/daydream/StarMakerEngin.tsx
            daydream: Music
            engin: StarMakerEngin
          - engin_file: components/daydream/GameEngin.tsx
            daydream: Games
            engin: GameEngin
          - engin_file: components/daydream/LabEngin.tsx
            daydream: Lab
            engin: LabEngin
          - engin_file: components/daydream/CodeEngin.tsx
            daydream: Code
            engin: CodeEngin
          - engin_file: components/daydream/BrandingEngin.tsx
            daydream: Brand
            engin: BrandingEngin
          - engin_file: components/daydream/ContentEngin.tsx
            daydream: Create
            engin: ContentEngin

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: ${{ env.PNPM_VERSION }}

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ env.NODE_VERSION }}
          cache: pnpm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      # ── ✦ Stylized ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
      - name: '✦ Stylized — design token scan'
        id: stylized-tokens
        run: |
          FILE="${{ matrix.engin_file }}"
          COUNT=$(grep -c 'var(--de-' "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
          echo "count=$COUNT" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          if [ "$COUNT" -gt 0 ]; then
            echo "✦ PASS design tokens ($COUNT usages)"
          else
            echo "⚠ WARN no --de-* tokens in $FILE"
          fi

      - name: '✦ Stylized — DreamWord treatment scan'
        id: stylized-dreamword
        run: |
          HITS=$(grep -rc 'de-dream-word\|DreamWord' components/ 2>/dev/null | awk -F: '{sum+=$2} END{print sum+0}')
          echo "count=$HITS" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "DreamWord usages across components/: $HITS"

      - name: '✦ Stylized — accent constant defined'
        id: stylized-accent
        run: |
          FILE="${{ matrix.engin_file }}"
          ACCENT=$(grep -c "const ACCENT = '" "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
          echo "defined=$ACCENT" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          [ "$ACCENT" -gt 0 ] && echo "✦ PASS accent constant present" || echo "⚠ WARN no ACCENT constant"

      # ── ◈ Intuitive ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
      - name: '◈ Intuitive — ARIA label coverage'
        id: intuitive-aria
        run: |
          FILE="${{ matrix.engin_file }}"
          ARIA=$(grep -c 'aria-label' "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
          echo "count=$ARIA" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "ARIA labels: $ARIA"
          [ "$ARIA" -gt 0 ] && echo "◈ PASS ARIA labels present" || echo "⚠ WARN missing ARIA labels"

      - name: '◈ Intuitive — hover/focus states'
        id: intuitive-hover
        run: |
          FILE="${{ matrix.engin_file }}"
          HOVER=$(grep -cE 'onMouseEnter|:hover|:focus' "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
          echo "count=$HOVER" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "Hover/focus patterns: $HOVER"

      - name: '◈ Intuitive — press feedback (de-pressable)'
        id: intuitive-press
        run: |
          FILE="${{ matrix.engin_file }}"
          PRESS=$(grep -c 'de-pressable\|de-card-pressable' "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
          echo "count=$PRESS" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "Press feedback usages: $PRESS"

      # ── ◎ Cohesive ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
      - name: '◎ Cohesive — border-radius consistency'
        id: cohesive-radius
        run: |
          FILE="${{ matrix.engin_file }}"
          CONSISTENT=$(grep -cE 'borderRadius: (8|10|12)' "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
          ARBITRARY=$(grep -cE 'borderRadius: [0-9]+' "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
          echo "consistent=$CONSISTENT" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "arbitrary=$ARBITRARY"   >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "Border-radius — consistent: $CONSISTENT, total numeric: $ARBITRARY"

      - name: '◎ Cohesive — transition timing'
        id: cohesive-transition
        run: |
          FILE="${{ matrix.engin_file }}"
          GOOD=$(grep -cE 'transition:.*0\.(15|2)s' "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
          echo "count=$GOOD" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "Standard transition timings (0.15s/0.2s): $GOOD"

      - name: '◎ Cohesive — bridge emits for key actions'
        id: cohesive-bridge
        run: |
          FILE="${{ matrix.engin_file }}"
          EMITS=$(grep -c "bridge\.emit(" "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
          echo "count=$EMITS" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          [ "$EMITS" -gt 0 ] && echo "◎ PASS bridge emits: $EMITS" || echo "⚠ WARN no bridge emits"

      # ── ◇ Coherent ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
      - name: '◇ Coherent — canonical naming (no rejected OS terms)'
        id: coherent-naming
        run: |
          FILE="${{ matrix.engin_file }}"
          VIOLATIONS=$(grep -ciE '\b(widget|engine|dashboard)\b' "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
          echo "violations=$VIOLATIONS" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          [ "$VIOLATIONS" -eq 0 ] && echo "◇ PASS no rejected OS terms" || echo "⚠ WARN $VIOLATIONS violations"

      - name: '◇ Coherent — back navigation present'
        id: coherent-backnav
        run: |
          FILE="${{ matrix.engin_file }}"
          BACKNAV=$(grep -c 'onBack' "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
          echo "count=$BACKNAV" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          [ "$BACKNAV" -gt 0 ] && echo "◇ PASS onBack prop present" || echo "⚠ WARN onBack missing"

      # ── ESLint refinement pass ─────────────────────────────────────────────
      - name: 'ESLint auto-fix (SICC refinement pass)'
        run: |
          pnpm exec eslint --fix ${{ matrix.engin_file }} || true

      - name: Commit SICC refinement fixes
        run: |
          git config user.name  "sicc-refine-bot[${{ matrix.daydream }}]"
          git config user.email "253588904+appthemanger-ctrl@users.noreply.github.com"
          if git diff --quiet && git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "No SICC fixes to commit."
          else
            git add -A
            git commit -m "refine(${{ matrix.daydream }}): SICC polish pass [skip ci] [skip vercel]"
            git push || true
          fi

      # ── Step summary ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
      - name: SICC report
        if: always()
        run: |
          echo "## ✦◈◎◇ SICC Report — ${{ matrix.daydream }} Daydream lobby / ${{ matrix.engin }} runtime" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "| Dimension  | Check                      | Result |" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "|------------|----------------------------|--------|" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "| ✦ Stylized  | Design tokens              | ${{ steps.stylized-tokens.outputs.count }} usages |" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "| ✦ Stylized  | Accent constant            | ${{ steps.stylized-accent.outputs.defined == '1' && 'defined ✓' || '⚠ missing' }} |" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "| ◈ Intuitive | ARIA labels                | ${{ steps.intuitive-aria.outputs.count }} labels |" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "| ◈ Intuitive | Hover states               | ${{ steps.intuitive-hover.outputs.count }} patterns |" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "| ◈ Intuitive | Press feedback             | ${{ steps.intuitive-press.outputs.count }} usages |" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "| ◎ Cohesive  | Border-radius consistency  | ${{ steps.cohesive-radius.outputs.consistent }} consistent |" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "| ◎ Cohesive  | Transition timing          | ${{ steps.cohesive-transition.outputs.count }} standard |" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "| ◎ Cohesive  | Bridge emits               | ${{ steps.cohesive-bridge.outputs.count }} emits |" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "| ◇ Coherent  | Rejected OS terms          | ${{ steps.coherent-naming.outputs.violations }} violations |" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "| ◇ Coherent  | Back navigation            | ${{ steps.coherent-backnav.outputs.count > '0' && 'present ✓' || '⚠ missing' }} |" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "Branch: \`${{ github.ref_name }}\` · Triggered by: ${{ github.event_name }}" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

name: DREAMengin Preflight

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
      - completedream
      - develop

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  preflight:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    outputs:
      chi: ${{ steps.score.outputs.chi }}
      mode: ${{ steps.score.outputs.mode }}
      app-root: ${{ steps.root.outputs.app_root }}
      changed-files: ${{ steps.score.outputs.changed_files }}
      allowed: ${{ steps.score.outputs.allowed }}

    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 10

      - name: Detect app root
        id: root
        shell: bash
        run: |
          APP_ROOT="."
          if [ -f "frontend/package.json" ]; then
            APP_ROOT="frontend"
          elif [ -f "src/package.json" ]; then
            APP_ROOT="src"
          elif [ -f "app/package.json" ]; then
            APP_ROOT="app"
          fi
          echo "app_root=$APP_ROOT" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "APP_ROOT=$APP_ROOT" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo "Detected app root: $APP_ROOT"

      - name: Setup pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10.33.0

      - name: Setup Node
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-node

      - name: Install dependencies
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cd "$APP_ROOT"
          pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Score pass / compute chi
        id: score
        shell: bash
        run: |
          node scripts/score-pass.cjs "$APP_ROOT"

      - name: Vercel preflight
        shell: bash
        run: |
          node scripts/vercel-preflight.cjs "$APP_ROOT"

      - name: DREAMengin spec check
        shell: bash
        run: |
          node scripts/spec-check.cjs "$APP_ROOT"

      - name: Typecheck
        # Warnings do not fail CI — only the build is a hard gate.
        # The base repo has pre-existing TS errors; typecheck is advisory.
        continue-on-error: true
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cd "$APP_ROOT"
          pnpm run typecheck

      - name: Lint
        # Lint warnings are advisory; only explicit errors matter.
        # Hard-failing on lint blocks real work — warnings must not gate the pipeline.
        continue-on-error: true
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cd "$APP_ROOT"
          pnpm run lint

      - name: Test CI
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cd "$APP_ROOT"
          pnpm run test:ci

      - name: Build
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cd "$APP_ROOT"
          pnpm run build

      - name: Print summary
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        run: |
          {
            echo "## DREAMengin Preflight"
            echo ""
            echo "| Item | Value |"
            echo "|------|-------|"
            echo "| App root | ${{ steps.root.outputs.app_root }} |"
            echo "| Changed files | ${{ steps.score.outputs.changed_files }} |"
            echo "| Chi score | ${{ steps.score.outputs.chi }} |"
            echo "| Mode | ${{ steps.score.outputs.mode }} |"
            echo "| Allowed | ${{ steps.score.outputs.allowed }} |"
          } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

name: Elite GameEngin Evolution 🚀

# DREAMengin Elite GameEngin Runtime — 2026
#
# The most comprehensive GameEngin runtime CI pipeline in the repo.
# Combines: WebGPU validation, AI-powered analysis, performance
# regression detection, game quality scoring, and automated
# improvement proposals.
#
# Triggers:
#   - Push to components/games/, lib/gameengin/, components/gameengin/
#   - Manual workflow dispatch (with optional AI directive)
#   - Daily at 06:00 UTC

on:
  push:
    paths:
      - 'components/games/**'
      - 'components/gameengin/**'
      - 'lib/gameengin/**'
      - '.github/workflows/elite-gameengin-evolution.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      directive:
        description: 'AI directive for this run (optional — e.g. "improve NeonDrift boss AI")'
        required: false
        default: ''
        type: string
      game_target:
        description: 'Target game ID from advanced-game-targets.json (optional)'
        required: false
        default: ''
        type: string
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 6 * * *'   # daily 06:00 UTC

permissions:
  contents: write
  issues: write
  pull-requests: write

concurrency:
  group: elite-gameengin-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

env:
  NODE_VERSION: '25'
  PNPM_VERSION: '10.30.0'
  GENERATED_DIR: .github/generated/elite

jobs:

  # ── Phase 1: Build & Lint Gate ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  build-gate:
    name: 🏗 Build + Lint + Typecheck
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    outputs:
      build_ok: ${{ steps.build.outcome == 'success' }}
      lint_warnings: ${{ steps.lint.outputs.warnings }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: ${{ env.PNPM_VERSION }}

      - name: Setup Node
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-node

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - id: build
        name: Build (Next.js)
        run: pnpm run build
        env:
          NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL:      ${{ secrets.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL }}
          NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY: ${{ secrets.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY }}

      - id: lint
        name: Lint GameEngin scope
        run: |
          WARNINGS=$(pnpm exec next lint \
            --dir components/games \
            --dir components/gameengin \
            --dir lib/gameengin \
            2>&1 | grep -c "Warning:" || true)
          echo "warnings=$WARNINGS" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          pnpm exec next lint \
            --dir components/games \
            --dir components/gameengin \
            --dir lib/gameengin || true

      - name: Typecheck
        run: pnpm typecheck || true

      - name: Game tests
        run: pnpm exec vitest run --reporter=verbose || true

      - name: Upload build artifacts
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: build-report
          path: .next/
          retention-days: 1

  # ── Phase 2: Quality Analysis ──────────────────────────────────────────────
  quality-analysis:
    name: 🔍 Game Quality Analysis
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: build-gate
    timeout-minutes: 15
    if: needs.build-gate.outputs.build_ok == 'true'

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: ${{ env.PNPM_VERSION }}

      - name: Setup Node
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-node

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Scan GameEngin context
        run: |
          mkdir -p ${{ env.GENERATED_DIR }}
          python .github/scripts/scan_dreamengin_context.py \
            > ${{ env.GENERATED_DIR }}/gameengin-context.md

      - name: Catalog game library
        run: |
          python .github/scripts/catalog_games_for_ai.py \
            > ${{ env.GENERATED_DIR }}/game-catalog.md

      - name: Compute game quality metrics
        run: |
          python3 - << 'EOF'
          import json, os, glob, re

          games_dir = "components/games"
          metrics = {}

          for path in glob.glob(f"{games_dir}/*.tsx"):
            name = os.path.basename(path).replace(".tsx", "")
            with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore") as f:
              src = f.read()

            lines = src.count("\n")
            has_webgpu = "WebGPUEngine" in src or "WebGPU" in src
            has_babylon = "BABYLON" in src or "@babylonjs" in src
            has_dual_sense = "DualSense" in src or "useGamepad" in src
            has_post_fx = "PostFX" in src or "GlowLayer" in src or "DefaultRenderingPipeline" in src
            has_ai = "AIDirector" in src or "tensorflow" in src or "tfjs" in src
            has_particle = "ParticleSystem" in src or "particle" in src.lower()
            has_audio = "AudioContext" in src or "Audio" in src
            has_leaderboard = "useSubmitScore" in src or "leaderboard" in src.lower()
            has_physics = "HavokPlugin" in src or "physics" in src.lower()
            has_combo = "combo" in src.lower()
            has_boss = "boss" in src.lower() or "Boss" in src
            has_procedural = "procedural" in src.lower() or "seededRng" in src or "seeded" in src.lower()
            has_fullscreen = "requestFullscreen" in src or "fullscreen" in src.lower()

            score = (
              (30 if has_webgpu else 0) +
              (20 if has_babylon else 0) +
              (10 if has_dual_sense else 0) +
              (15 if has_post_fx else 0) +
              (10 if has_ai else 0) +
              (8  if has_particle else 0) +
              (5  if has_audio else 0) +
              (5  if has_leaderboard else 0) +
              (10 if has_physics else 0) +
              (5  if has_combo else 0) +
              (8  if has_boss else 0) +
              (8  if has_procedural else 0) +
              (4  if has_fullscreen else 0) +
              min(10, lines // 100)
            )

            metrics[name] = {
              "lines": lines,
              "engineScore": score,
              "features": {
                "webgpu": has_webgpu,
                "babylon": has_babylon,
                "dualSense": has_dual_sense,
                "postFx": has_post_fx,
                "aiDirector": has_ai,
                "particles": has_particle,
                "audio": has_audio,
                "leaderboard": has_leaderboard,
                "physics": has_physics,
                "combo": has_combo,
                "bossFights": has_boss,
                "procedural": has_procedural,
                "fullscreen": has_fullscreen,
              }
            }

          # Sort by score descending
          ranked = sorted(metrics.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1]["engineScore"])

          out = {
            "totalGames": len(metrics),
            "eliteGames": [n for n, m in ranked if m["engineScore"] >= 60],
            "avgScore": sum(m["engineScore"] for m in metrics.values()) // max(1, len(metrics)),
            "topGame": ranked[0][0] if ranked else None,
            "ranked": [{"name": n, **m} for n, m in ranked],
          }

          os.makedirs("${{ env.GENERATED_DIR }}", exist_ok=True)
          with open("${{ env.GENERATED_DIR }}/quality-metrics.json", "w") as f:
            json.dump(out, f, indent=2)

          print(f"✅ Analyzed {len(metrics)} games")
          print(f"🏆 Top game: {out['topGame']}")
          print(f"🎮 Elite games (≥60): {out['eliteGames']}")
          print(f"📊 Avg score: {out['avgScore']}")

          # Write summary
          with open("$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY", "a") as f:
            f.write("## 🎮 Game Quality Report\n\n")
            f.write(f"| Metric | Value |\n|--------|-------|\n")
            f.write(f"| Total games | {out['totalGames']} |\n")
            f.write(f"| Elite games (score ≥ 60) | {len(out['eliteGames'])} |\n")
            f.write(f"| Average GameEngin score | {out['avgScore']} |\n")
            f.write(f"| Top game | {out['topGame']} |\n\n")
            f.write("### Rankings\n\n| Game | Score | Features |\n|------|-------|----------|\n")
            for item in ranked[:10]:
              feats = [k for k, v in item["features"].items() if v]
              f.write(f"| {item['name']} | {item['engineScore']} | {', '.join(feats[:5])} |\n")
          EOF

      - name: Upload quality metrics
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: quality-metrics
          path: ${{ env.GENERATED_DIR }}/quality-metrics.json
          retention-days: 7

  # ── Phase 3: AI Evolution Proposals ───────────────────────────────────────
  ai-evolution:
    name: 🤖 AI Evolution Proposals
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: quality-analysis
    timeout-minutes: 20
    if: ${{ secrets.OPENAI_API_KEY != '' }}
    env:
      OPENAI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENAI_API_KEY }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Download quality metrics
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4.1.3
        with:
          name: quality-metrics
          path: ${{ env.GENERATED_DIR }}

      - name: Generate AI evolution spec
        id: ai_spec
        run: |
          mkdir -p ${{ env.GENERATED_DIR }}

          DIRECTIVE="${{ github.event.inputs.directive }}"
          GAME_TARGET="${{ github.event.inputs.game_target }}"
          METRICS=$(cat ${{ env.GENERATED_DIR }}/quality-metrics.json 2>/dev/null || echo "{}")
          ADV_TARGETS=$(cat config/advanced-game-targets.json 2>/dev/null || echo "{}")

          RESPONSE=$(curl -s https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions \
            -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPENAI_API_KEY" \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -d "$(jq -n \
              --arg metrics "$METRICS" \
              --arg targets "$ADV_TARGETS" \
              --arg directive "$DIRECTIVE" \
              --arg game_target "$GAME_TARGET" \
              '{
                model: "gpt-4.1",
                response_format: { type: "json_object" },
                max_tokens: 2000,
                messages: [{
                  role: "system",
                  content: "You are the DREAMengin Elite GameEngin Evolution AI. Your job is to propose concrete, implementable upgrades to push DREAMengin toward being the best web browser GameEngin runtime in 2026. Focus on: WebGPU rendering, post-processing FX, AI-driven gameplay, procedural content, physics depth, and combat systems. Always ground proposals in the existing Babylon.js + React + TypeScript stack."
                },{
                  role: "user",
                  content: ("Game quality metrics:\n" + $metrics + "\n\nAdvanced targets:\n" + $targets + "\n\nDirective: " + (if $directive != "" then $directive else "evolve the weakest-scoring game with the most impactful elite GameEngin features" end) + "\n\nGame target: " + (if $game_target != "" then $game_target else "auto-select from advanced targets" end) + "\n\nOutput JSON only:\n{\"target_game\":\"...\",\"upgrade_theme\":\"...\",\"priority_features\":[\"...\"],\"implementation_plan\":[{\"step\":1,\"description\":\"...\",\"files\":[\"...\"],\"estimated_lines\":0}],\"expected_score_improvement\":0,\"rationale\":\"...\"}")
                }]
              }')"
          )

          SPEC=$(echo "$RESPONSE" | jq -r '.choices[0].message.content // empty')
          if [ -n "$SPEC" ]; then
            echo "$SPEC" > ${{ env.GENERATED_DIR }}/evolution-spec.json
            echo "spec_generated=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "Target: $(echo "$SPEC" | jq -r '.target_game // "unknown"')"
            echo "Theme: $(echo "$SPEC" | jq -r '.upgrade_theme // "unknown"')"
          else
            echo "spec_generated=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "⚠️ AI spec generation failed — API may be unavailable"
          fi

      - name: Save evolution spec as artifact
        if: steps.ai_spec.outputs.spec_generated == 'true'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: evolution-spec
          path: ${{ env.GENERATED_DIR }}/evolution-spec.json
          retention-days: 30

      - name: Write evolution summary
        if: steps.ai_spec.outputs.spec_generated == 'true'
        run: |
          python3 - << 'EOF'
          import json, os

          spec_path = "${{ env.GENERATED_DIR }}/evolution-spec.json"
          try:
            with open(spec_path) as f:
              spec = json.load(f)
          except Exception:
            spec = {}

          with open(os.environ.get("GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY", "/dev/stdout"), "a") as f:
            f.write("## 🤖 AI Evolution Proposal\n\n")
            f.write(f"**Target game:** `{spec.get('target_game', 'N/A')}`\n\n")
            f.write(f"**Upgrade theme:** {spec.get('upgrade_theme', 'N/A')}\n\n")
            f.write(f"**Priority features:**\n")
            for feat in spec.get('priority_features', []):
              f.write(f"- {feat}\n")
            f.write(f"\n**Expected score improvement:** +{spec.get('expected_score_improvement', 0)}\n\n")
            f.write(f"**Rationale:** {spec.get('rationale', 'N/A')}\n\n")
            f.write("### Implementation Plan\n\n")
            for step in spec.get('implementation_plan', []):
              files = ', '.join(f"`{f}`" for f in step.get('files', []))
              f.write(f"{step.get('step', '?')}. **{step.get('description', '')}** — {files}\n")
          EOF

  # ── Phase 4: Auto-Fix & Commit ────────────────────────────────────────────
  autofix:
    name: 🔧 ESLint Auto-Fix + Commit

name: GameEngin Bug Patrol

# The 7th action — mimics GameEngin's control-layer role in CI.
# Scans all games code just as GameEngin scans player scores and game state.
#
# Covers every file that GameEngin manages at runtime:
#   - components/games/       — WordSprint, MemoryGrid, SpeedTap, GameRemote, Leaderboard
#   - components/daydream/GameEngin.tsx — the Engin runtime itself
#   - app/game/               — Dr. Eams Platformer (GamePageClient)
#   - app/daydream/games/     — Games Daydream (GamesHub)
#   - app/api/game-scores/    — score submission API
#
# Steps:
#   1. Checkout + install
#   2. Typecheck games scope
#   3. Lint games scope (report mode)
#   4. ESLint auto-fix games scope
#   5. Unit tests for games components
#   6. Scan for known game-bug patterns (unguarded setInterval, missing cleanup)
#   7. Commit + push any auto-fixes
#   8. Upload patrol report

on:
  push:
    paths:
      - 'components/games/**'
      - 'components/daydream/GameEngin.tsx'
      - 'app/game/**'
      - 'app/daydream/games/**'
      - 'app/api/game-scores/**'
  workflow_dispatch:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 4 * * *'   # daily 04:00 UTC — before the daydream-games workflow

permissions:
  contents: write

concurrency:
  group: game-engin-patrol-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

env:
  NODE_VERSION: '25'
  PNPM_VERSION: '10.30.0'

jobs:
  patrol:
    name: GameEngin · Bug Patrol · Scan · Fix
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20

    steps:
      # ── Checkout ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      # ── Toolchain ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
      - name: Setup pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: ${{ env.PNPM_VERSION }}

      - name: Setup Node
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-node

      # ── Install ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      # ── Typecheck (games scope) ───────────────────────────────────────────────
      - name: Typecheck games scope
        run: |
          pnpm exec tsc --noEmit \
            --allowJs false 2>&1 | grep -E "(components/games|app/game|GameEngin)" || true

      # ── Lint report (games scope) ─────────────────────────────────────────────
      - name: Lint games scope (report)
        id: lint_report
        run: |
          pnpm lint \
            --file components/games \
            --file components/daydream/GameEngin.tsx \
            --file app/game \
            --file app/daydream/games \
            2>&1 | tee /tmp/game-lint-report.txt \
            && echo "lint_ok=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT" \
            || echo "lint_ok=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      # ── ESLint auto-fix (games scope) ─────────────────────────────────────────
      - name: ESLint auto-fix games scope
        run: |
          pnpm exec next lint \
            --fix \
            --dir components/games \
            --dir app/game \
            --dir app/daydream/games \
            || true

      # ── Unit tests (full suite — games components included) ───────────────────
      - name: Unit tests
        run: pnpm exec vitest run --reporter=verbose || true

      # ── Pattern scan: common game-component bugs ──────────────────────────────
      - name: Scan for unguarded setInterval / missing cleanup
        id: pattern_scan
        run: |
          echo "## GameEngin Bug Patrol — Pattern Scan" > /tmp/patrol-report.txt
          echo "" >> /tmp/patrol-report.txt

          # setInterval without clearInterval in same file
          echo "### Unguarded setInterval" >> /tmp/patrol-report.txt
          grep -rn "setInterval" components/games/ app/game/ app/daydream/games/ \
            --include="*.tsx" --include="*.ts" 2>/dev/null \
            | grep -v "clearInterval" >> /tmp/patrol-report.txt || echo "None found." >> /tmp/patrol-report.txt

          # useEffect without return cleanup
          echo "" >> /tmp/patrol-report.txt
          echo "### useEffect blocks in games files" >> /tmp/patrol-report.txt
          grep -rn "useEffect" components/games/ components/daydream/GameEngin.tsx \
            --include="*.tsx" 2>/dev/null >> /tmp/patrol-report.txt || echo "None found." >> /tmp/patrol-report.txt

          # Missing key props in mapped lists
          echo "" >> /tmp/patrol-report.txt
          echo "### .map() without obvious key prop" >> /tmp/patrol-report.txt
          grep -rn "\.map(" components/games/ components/daydream/GameEngin.tsx \
            --include="*.tsx" 2>/dev/null >> /tmp/patrol-report.txt || echo "None found." >> /tmp/patrol-report.txt

          cat /tmp/patrol-report.txt

      # ── Commit auto-fixes ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
      - name: Commit auto-fixes (if any)
        run: |
          git config user.name  "game-engin-patrol-bot"
          git config user.email "253588904+appthemanger-ctrl@users.noreply.github.com"
          if git diff --quiet && git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "No fixes to commit — all games code is clean."
          else
            git add -A
            git commit -m "fix(games): GameEngin patrol auto-fix [skip ci] [skip vercel]"
            git push || true
      - name: Upload patrol report
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: game-engin-patrol-report-${{ github.run_number }}
          path: /tmp/patrol-report.txt
          retention-days: 14

      # ── Summary ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
      - name: Job summary
        if: always()
        run: |
          echo "## 🎮 GameEngin Bug Patrol Report" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "| Item | Value |" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "|------|-------|" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "| Engin runtime | GameEngin |" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "| Lint OK | ${{ steps.lint_report.outputs.lint_ok }} |" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "| Branch | \`${{ github.ref_name }}\` |" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "| Commit | \`${{ github.sha }}\` |" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "| Triggered by | ${{ github.event_name }} |" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "### Games covered" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "- Dr. Eams Platformer (\`app/game/\`)" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "- Word Sprint (\`components/games/WordSprint.tsx\`)" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "- Memory Grid (\`components/games/MemoryGrid.tsx\`)" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "- Speed Tap (\`components/games/SpeedTap.tsx\`)" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "- GameRemote (\`components/games/GameRemote.tsx\`)" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "- Leaderboard (\`components/games/Leaderboard.tsx\`)" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "- GameEngin runtime layer (\`components/daydream/GameEngin.tsx\`)" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          if [ -f /tmp/patrol-report.txt ]; then

jobs:
  gameengin-ai-loop:
    name: Design + Generate + Validate Game for GameEngin
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
    env:
      OPENAI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENAI_API_KEY }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout

      - name: AI propose SICC genre-mix game

            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \

              --arg context "$CONTEXT" \

                  role: "user",

No standalone Next.js routes may run the game directly.\n- It must be a unique genre combination relative to existing games.\n- It must be SICC: Stylized (strong visual identity), Intuitive (controls obvious from moment 1), Cohesive (mechanics + UI reinforce same idea), Coherent (no random systems).\n- It must be fun: tight core loop, clear reward structure, readable fail states.\n\nCurrent GameEngin runtime + games context:\n" + $context + "\n\nTask:\n1. Invent exactly ONE new game.\n2. Output JSON only matching this schema:\n{\"title\":\"...\",\"slug\":\"unique_slug\",\"entrypoint\":\"games/unique_slug\",\"route\":\"/daydream/games/unique_slug\",\"summary\":\"...\",\"core_loop\":\"...\",\"camera\":\"...\",\"controls\":{\"keyboard\":\"...\",\"gamepad\":\"...\"},\"win_state\":\"...\",\"lose_state\":\"...\",\"progression\":\"...\",\"genres\":[\"...\"],\"sicc\":{\"stylized\":\"...\",\"intuitive\":\"...\",\"cohesive\":\"...\",\"coherent\":\"...\"},\"dream_windows\":[\"...\"],\"privacy_notes\":\"...\"}")
                }]
              }')"
          )
          echo "completion=$(echo "$RESPONSE" | jq -r '.choices[0].message.content // empty')" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Save game design spec

          CHARS=$(cat "$CHARS_JSON" 2>/dev/null || echo "{}")
          LOGIC=$(cat "$LOGIC_JSON" 2>/dev/null || echo "{}")
          RESPONSE=$(curl -s https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions \
            -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPENAI_API_KEY" \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -d "$(jq -n \
              --arg design "$DESIGN" \
              --arg chars "$CHARS" \
              --arg logic "$LOGIC" \
              '{
                model: "gpt-4.1",
                response_format: { type: "json_object" },
                messages: [{
                  role: "user",
                  content: ("You are the narrative design AI for the DREAMengin Games Daydream lobby.\n\nGame design:\n" + $design + "\n\nCharacters:\n" + $chars + "\n\nLogic:\n" + $logic + "\n\nRules:\n- Write an original, non-derivative story.\n- Cover world background, mythology, current conflict, main character arc, secondary arcs, and how gameplay reflects story beats.\n- Match SICC tone and be coherent with mechanics and Dream Window states.\n- Be implementable as in-game text, VO, or environmental storytelling.\n- DO NOT output code, only structured narrative.\n\nOutput JSON only:\n{\"world_background\":\"...\",\"mythology\":\"...\",\"setup\":\"...\",\"chapters\":[{\"id\":1,\"title\":\"...\",\"summary\":\"...\",\"key_gameplay_beats\":[\"...\"]}],\"character_arcs\":{\"main\":\"...\",\"secondary\":[{\"name\":\"...\",\"arc\":\"...\"}]},\"ending_variants\":[{\"id\":\"good\",\"conditions\":[\"...\"],\"summary\":\"...\"},{\"id\":\"bad\",\"conditions\":[\"...\"],\"summary\":\"...\"}]}")
                }]
              }')"
          )
          echo "completion=$(echo "$RESPONSE" | jq -r '.choices[0].message.content // empty')" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Save game narrative
        run: |
          echo '${{ steps.ai_story.outputs.completion }}' > .github/generated/game-story.json

      # 6. AI generate GameEngin-compatible game code
      - name: AI generate GameEngin-compatible game code
        id: ai_generate
        env:
          DESIGN_JSON: .github/generated/game-design.json
          CHARS_JSON: .github/generated/game-characters.json
          LOGIC_JSON: .github/generated/game-logic.json
          STORY_JSON: .github/generated/game-story.json
        run: |
          DESIGN=$(cat "$DESIGN_JSON" 2>/dev/null || echo "{}")
          CHARS=$(cat "$CHARS_JSON" 2>/dev/null || echo "{}")
          LOGIC=$(cat "$LOGIC_JSON" 2>/dev/null || echo "{}")
          STORY=$(cat "$STORY_JSON" 2>/dev/null || echo "{}")
          RESPONSE=$(curl -s https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions \
            -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPENAI_API_KEY" \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -d "$(jq -n \
              --arg design "$DESIGN" \
              --arg chars "$CHARS" \
              --arg logic "$LOGIC" \
              --arg story "$STORY" \
              '{
                model: "gpt-4.1",
                messages: [{
                  role: "user",
                  content: ("You are the GameEngin implementation AI for DREAMengin.\n\nTech: Next.js 16 App Router, React 19, TypeScript, Babylon.js 8+ WebGPU-first, GameEngin runtime APIs and Dream Windows, Supabase with RLS.\n\nDesign: " + $design + "\nCharacters: " + $chars + "\nLogic: " + $logic + "\nStory: " + $story + "\n\nRules:\n- Implement or extend the game at 'entrypoint' under games/**.\n- Only touch games/** and engine/gameengin/**.\n- Use TS/TSX with strict types.\n- Bind logic state to Babylon scenes and Dream Windows.\n- Reflect story beats via HUD, events, or environmental cues.\n- Uphold SICC; if a mechanic conflicts with coherence, favor coherence.\n\nOutput: Unified diff (git patch) only.")
                }]
              }')"
          )
          echo "completion=$(echo "$RESPONSE" | jq -r '.choices[0].message.content // empty')" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Apply AI patch
        continue-on-error: true
        run: |
          mkdir -p .github/generated
          echo '${{ steps.ai_generate.outputs.completion }}' > .github/generated/game-patch.diff
          git apply .github/generated/game-patch.diff || true

      # 7. Disc-only sandbox rule: games must only run via GameEngin
      - name: Validate game sandbox rules (disc-only via GameEngin)
        run: |
          python .github/scripts/validate_game_sandbox.py

      # 8. Game-only build gate: do not commit if games break the GameEngin/games build
      - name: Setup pnpm ${{ env.PNPM_VERSION }}
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: ${{ env.PNPM_VERSION }}

      - name: Setup Node ${{ env.NODE_VERSION }}
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-node

      - name: Install deps (game gate)
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Build GameEngin + games (gate)
        run: pnpm run build:gamesengin
        env:
          NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL:      ${{ secrets.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL }}
          NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY: ${{ secrets.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY }}

      - name: Test games (gate)
        run: pnpm run test:games

      - name: Commit AI changes (if any)
        if: success()
        continue-on-error: true
        run: |
          if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then
            git config user.name "GameEngin AI Agent"
            git config user.email "253588904+appthemanger-ctrl@users.noreply.github.com"
            git commit -am "AI: add/update SICC game for GameEngin"
          fi

      - name: Push AI changes (same branch)
        if: success()
        continue-on-error: true
        run: |
          if [ -n "$(git log origin/${GITHUB_REF_NAME}..HEAD 2>/dev/null)" ]; then
            git push origin HEAD:${GITHUB_REF_NAME}
          fi

      # 9. Optional: global build + tests, non-blocking
      - name: Build DREAMengin (full app)
        continue-on-error: true
        env:
          NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED: 1
          NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL:      ${{ secrets.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL }}
          NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY: ${{ secrets.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY }}
        run: pnpm build

      - name: Run full test suite
        continue-on-error: true
        run: pnpm test

name: Neural Decision Engine

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      directive:
        description: 'Optional direction for the decision engine (for example: "push the games shell harder")'
        required: false
        default: ''
        type: string
      commit_changes:
        description: 'Commit validated implementation changes back to the current branch'
        required: false
        default: true
        type: boolean
  push:
    branches: [main, develop, completedream]
    paths:
      - 'README.md'
      - 'docs/**'
      - 'spec/**'
      - 'app/**'
      - 'components/**'
      - 'lib/**'
      - 'styles/**'
      - '.github/scripts/**.py'
      - '.github/workflows/neural_decision_engine.yml'
  schedule:
    - cron: '15 7 * * *'

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

concurrency:
  group: neural-decision-engine-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

env:
  NODE_VERSION: '25'
  PNPM_VERSION: '10.30.0'
  GENERATED_DIR: .github/generated/neural-decision

jobs:
  scan:
    name: Scan DREAMengin world model
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Scan repository context
        run: |
          mkdir -p "${{ env.GENERATED_DIR }}"
          python .github/scripts/scan_dreamengin_context.py \
            > "${{ env.GENERATED_DIR }}/dreamengin-context.md"

      - name: Upload context artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: neural-decision-context
          path: ${{ env.GENERATED_DIR }}/dreamengin-context.md
          retention-days: 1

  decide:
    name: Score options and pick the next move
    needs: scan
    if: ${{ secrets.OPENAI_API_KEY != '' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Download context artifact
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4.1.3
        with:
          name: neural-decision-context
          path: ${{ env.GENERATED_DIR }}

      - name: Generate neural decision packet
        env:
          OPENAI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENAI_API_KEY }}
          DIRECTIVE: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.directive || '' }}
        run: |
          python .github/scripts/ai_neural_decision.py \
            --context "${{ env.GENERATED_DIR }}/dreamengin-context.md" \
            --out "${{ env.GENERATED_DIR }}/neural-decision.json" \
            --model gpt-4.1 \
            --directive "$DIRECTIVE"

      - name: Upload decision artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: neural-decision-packet
          path: ${{ env.GENERATED_DIR }}/neural-decision.json
          retention-days: 7

      - name: Write decision summary
        run: |
          python - <<'PY'
          import json
          import os

          path = os.path.join(os.environ["GENERATED_DIR"], "neural-decision.json")
          with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
            data = json.load(fh)

          selected = data.get("selected_option", {})
          matrix = data.get("decision_matrix", [])
          summary_path = os.environ.get("GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY", "/dev/stdout")

          with open(summary_path, "a", encoding="utf-8") as out:
            out.write("## Neural Decision Packet\n\n")
            out.write(f"**Winner:** {selected.get('title', data.get('title', 'Unknown'))}\n\n")
            reason = data.get("selected_option_reason", "")
            if reason:
              out.write(f"**Why this wins:** {reason}\n\n")
            out.write("| Option | Total | Immersion | Clarity | Leverage | Buildability | Novelty | Risk |\n")
            out.write("|--------|-------|-----------|---------|----------|--------------|---------|------|\n")
            for option in matrix:
              score = option.get("scorecard", {})
              out.write(
                f"| {option.get('title', option.get('id', 'option'))} | "
                f"{score.get('total', '')} | {score.get('immersion', '')} | "
                f"{score.get('clarity', '')} | {score.get('leverage', '')} | "
                f"{score.get('buildability', '')} | {score.get('novelty', '')} | "
                f"{score.get('risk_management', '')} |\n"
              )
            out.write("\n")
            out.write(f"**First slice:** {data.get('v1_scope', {}).get('description', 'N/A')}\n")
          PY

  implement:
    name: Implement the selected move
    needs: [scan, decide]
    if: ${{ needs.decide.result == 'success' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 35

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Download context artifact
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4.1.3.1.3
        with:
          name: neural-decision-context
          path: ${{ env.GENERATED_DIR }}

      - name: Download decision artifact
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4.1.3.1.3
        with:
          name: neural-decision-packet
          path: ${{ env.GENERATED_DIR }}

      - name: Generate implementation patch
        env:
          OPENAI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENAI_API_KEY }}
        run: |
          python .github/scripts/ai_implement.py \
            --context "${{ env.GENERATED_DIR }}/dreamengin-context.md" \
            --spec "${{ env.GENERATED_DIR }}/neural-decision.json" \
            --out "${{ env.GENERATED_DIR }}/neural-decision.patch.diff" \
            --model gpt-4.1

      - name: Apply patch
        id: apply-patch
        continue-on-error: true
        run: |
          if [ -s "${{ env.GENERATED_DIR }}/neural-decision.patch.diff" ]; then
            git apply --check "${{ env.GENERATED_DIR }}/neural-decision.patch.diff" && \
            git apply "${{ env.GENERATED_DIR }}/neural-decision.patch.diff" && \
            echo "applied=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT" || \
            echo "applied=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo "applied=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

      - name: Setup Node
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-node

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Build DREAMengin
        run: pnpm run build
        env:
          NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL: ${{ secrets.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL }}
          NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY: ${{ secrets.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY }}

      - name: Run Vitest suite
        run: pnpm run test

      - name: Commit validated changes
        if: success() && steps.apply-patch.outputs.applied == 'true' && (github.event_name == 'schedule' || (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.commit_changes))
        run: |
          git config user.name "neural-decision-engine"
          git config user.email "253588904+appthemanger-ctrl@users.noreply.github.com"
          if ! git diff --quiet || ! git diff --cached --quiet; then
            git add -A
            git commit -m "AI: neural decision engine v1 [skip ci] [skip vercel]"
          else
            echo "Nothing to commit."
          fi

      - name: Push validated changes
        if: success() && steps.apply-patch.outputs.applied == 'true' && (github.event_name == 'schedule' || (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.commit_changes))
        run: |
          if git log origin/${{ github.ref_name }}..HEAD --oneline | grep -q .; then
            git push origin HEAD:${{ github.ref_name }}
          else
            echo "Nothing new to push."
          fi

      - name: Pipeline summary
        if: always()
        run: |
          echo "## Neural Decision Engine" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "| Step | Result |" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "|------|--------|" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "| Decision packet | ${{ needs.decide.result == 'success' && '✅' || '⚠️ skipped/failed' }} |" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "| Patch applied | ${{ steps.apply-patch.outputs.applied == 'true' && '✅' || '⚠️ skipped/failed' }} |" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "| Build + test gate | ${{ job.status == 'success' && '✅' || '❌' }} |" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "Branch: \`${{ github.ref_name }}\` · Triggered by: ${{ github.event_name }}" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

name: DREAMengin Optimization

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      optimization_target:
        description: 'Optimization target (feed, search, widgets, layout, assets, render, cache, notifications, offline, routing, all)'
        required: false
        default: 'all'
        type: choice
        options:
          - all
          - feed
          - search
          - widgets
          - layout
          - assets
          - render
          - cache
          - notifications
          - offline
          - routing
  schedule:
    # Run daily at 3 AM UTC
    - cron: '0 3 * * *'

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  optimize:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10.33.0

      - name: Setup Node
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-node

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run DREAMengin optimizer
        id: optimizer
        run: |
          node scripts/optimize-dreamengin.mjs \
            --target="${{ github.event.inputs.optimization_target || 'all' }}" \
            --config=config/optimizer.yaml \
            --output=.optimization-results.json

      - name: Read optimization results
        id: results
        run: |
          if [ -f .optimization-results.json ]; then
            echo "Results file found"
            cat .optimization-results.json

            # Extract key metrics using Node.js
            node -e "
              const fs = require('fs');
              const results = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('.optimization-results.json', 'utf8'));
              console.log('algorithm=' + results.algorithm);
              console.log('target=' + results.target);
              console.log('objective_value=' + results.objective_value);
              console.log('constraints_satisfied=' + results.constraints_satisfied);
              console.log('optimization_score=' + results.optimization_score);
            " >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "algorithm=constraint-solver" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "target=${{ github.event.inputs.optimization_target || 'all' }}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "objective_value=0" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "constraints_satisfied=0" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "optimization_score=0" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Print optimization summary
        run: |
          echo "## DREAMengin Optimization Summary" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "- **Algorithm**: ${{ steps.results.outputs.algorithm }}" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "- **Target**: ${{ steps.results.outputs.target }}" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "- **Objective value**: ${{ steps.results.outputs.objective_value }}" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "- **Constraints satisfied**: ${{ steps.results.outputs.constraints_satisfied }}" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "- **Optimization score**: ${{ steps.results.outputs.optimization_score }}" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY

          echo "Algorithm: ${{ steps.results.outputs.algorithm }}"
          echo "Target: ${{ steps.results.outputs.target }}"
          echo "Objective value: ${{ steps.results.outputs.objective_value }}"
          echo "Constraints satisfied: ${{ steps.results.outputs.constraints_satisfied }}"
          echo "Optimization score: ${{ steps.results.outputs.optimization_score }}"

      - name: Upload optimization results
        if: always() && hashFiles('.optimization-results.json') != ''
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: optimization-results-${{ github.run_number }}
          path: .optimization-results.json
          retention-days: 30

      - name: Comment on PR if triggered from PR
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          script: |
            const fs = require('fs');
            let results = {};

            if (fs.existsSync('.optimization-results.json')) {
              results = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('.optimization-results.json', 'utf8'));
            }

            const comment = `## 🎯 DREAMengin Optimization Results

            | Metric | Value |
            |--------|-------|
            | Algorithm | ${results.algorithm || 'N/A'} |
            | Target | ${results.target || 'N/A'} |
            | Objective Value | ${results.objective_value || 'N/A'} |
            | Constraints Satisfied | ${results.constraints_satisfied || 'N/A'} |
            | Optimization Score | ${results.optimization_score || 'N/A'} |

            **Optimizations Applied:**
            ${results.optimizations ? results.optimizations.map(opt => `- ${opt.name}: ${opt.description}`).join('\n') : 'None'}
            `;

            github.rest.issues.createComment({
              issue_number: context.issue.number,
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              body: comment
            });

name: Spec-Engin AI Agent

# DREAMengin AI big-move loop
#
# Three-job pipeline:
#   1. scan    — snapshot docs + code into a large-context file
#   2. propose — GPT-4.1 designs ONE creative, SICC-aligned platform change
#   3. implement — GPT-4.1 writes the first slice as a git patch,
#                  applies it, then builds + tests to gate the commit
#
# SICC has TWO canon meanings (both enforced in prompts):
#   Super Immersive Creative Controls  (immersion)
#   Stylized · Intuitive · Cohesive · Coherent  (clarity)
#
# Required repository secret:  OPENAI_API_KEY

      - 'docs/**'
      - 'spec/**'
      - 'README.md'
      - '.github/workflows/spec-engin-ai-agent.yml'
      - '.github/scripts/**.py'

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

concurrency:
  group: spec-engin-ai-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

  NODE_VERSION: '25'
  PNPM_VERSION: '10.30.0'
  GENERATED_DIR: .github/generated

  propose:

          IDEA=$(python -c  "import json,sys; d=json.load(open('${{ env.GENERATED_DIR }}/dreamengin-spec.json')); print(d.get('big_idea','')[:400])" 2>/dev/null || echo "")

  implement:
    name: AI implement big move v1 — build + test — commit
    needs: propose

    timeout-minutes: 30

            --context ${{ env.GENERATED_DIR }}/dreamengin-context.md \
            --spec    ${{ env.GENERATED_DIR }}/dreamengin-spec.json \
            --out     ${{ env.GENERATED_DIR }}/dreamengin-patch.diff \
            --model   gpt-4.1

      # ── Apply patch (non-fatal: a bad patch should not break the pipeline) ─
      - name: Apply AI patch
        id: apply-patch
        continue-on-error: true
        run: |
          if [ -s "${{ env.GENERATED_DIR }}/dreamengin-patch.diff" ]; then
            git apply --check ${{ env.GENERATED_DIR }}/dreamengin-patch.diff 2>&1 && \
              git apply ${{ env.GENERATED_DIR }}/dreamengin-patch.diff && \
              echo "applied=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT" || \
              echo "applied=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo "No patch content — skipping apply."
            echo "applied=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

      # ── Install + build + test (hard gate) ────────────────────────────────
      - name: Setup pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: ${{ env.PNPM_VERSION }}

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ env.NODE_VERSION }}
          cache: pnpm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Build DREAMengin (Next.js)
        run: pnpm run build
        env:
          NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL:      ${{ secrets.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL }}
          NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY: ${{ secrets.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY }}

      - name: Run Vitest tests
        run: pnpm run test

      # ── Commit if build + tests passed ────────────────────────────────────
      - name: Commit DREAMengin big-move v1
        if: success() && steps.apply-patch.outputs.applied == 'true'
        run: |
          git config user.name  "Spec-Engin AI Agent"
          git config user.email "253588904+appthemanger-ctrl@users.noreply.github.com"
          if ! git diff --quiet || ! git diff --cached --quiet; then
            git add -A
            git commit -m "AI: big-move v1 for DREAMengin [skip ci] [skip vercel]"
          else
            echo "Nothing to commit after patch."
          fi

      - name: Push DREAMengin changes
        if: success() && steps.apply-patch.outputs.applied == 'true'
        run: |
          if git log origin/${{ github.ref_name }}..HEAD --oneline | grep -q .; then
            git push origin HEAD:${{ github.ref_name }}
          else
            echo "Nothing new to push."
          fi

      # ── Step summary ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
      - name: Pipeline summary
        if: always()
        run: |
          echo "## Spec-Engin AI Agent — Pipeline Summary" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "| Step | Result |" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "|------|--------|" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "| Context scan      | ✅ |" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "| Spec proposal     | ✅ |" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "| Patch applied     | ${{ steps.apply-patch.outputs.applied == 'true' && '✅' || '⚠ skipped/failed' }} |" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "| Build + tests     | ${{ job.status == 'success' && '✅' || '❌' }} |" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "Branch: \`${{ github.ref_name }}\` · Triggered by: ${{ github.event_name }}" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
